topicName: Latency, Throughput, and Scaling Strategies for LLMs
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Latency, Throughput, and Scaling Strategies for LLMs"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in production environments requires balancing three competing pillars: latency, throughput, and operational cost. Unlike traditional software, LLM inference is compute-bound during the prompt processing (prefill) phase and memory-bandwidth-bound during the token generation (decode) phase."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Core Metrics: Latency vs. Throughput"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Time to First Token (TTFT): The latency experienced by the user before the model generates the first word. Crucial for conversational responsiveness."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Time Per Output Token (TPOT): The inverse of generation speed, measuring how fast subsequent tokens are streamed."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Throughput: Measured in tokens per second (tokens/s) across all concurrent requests, dictating system capacity and economics."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Scaling Strategies for Production"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"To handle high concurrency and reduce latency, engineers employ several architectural strategies, including continuous batching, quantization, and tensor parallelism."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

# Initialize vLLM with tensor parallelism for high throughput
llm = LLM(model="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct", tensor_parallel_size=2)
sampling_params = SamplingParams(temperature=0.7, max_tokens=256)

outputs = llm.generate(["Explain quantum computing in simple terms."], sampling_params)"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Optimizing LLM inference is an iterative process. By leveraging continuous batching, KV caching, and distributed inference engines like vLLM or TensorRT-LLM, organizations can drastically reduce infrastructure costs while maintaining low user-facing latencies."}]
